title: A Hybrid Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Computing Dispersion Relations of SH Waves in Generalized Hetrogeneous Layered Media with Applications
summary: This work presents a mathematical and computational framework for computing the dispersion relations of shear horizontal (SH) waves in continuously varying heterogeneous layered structures. The approach isolates the contribution of the heterogeneous layer from the complete dispersion relation, learns this contribution using a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and subsequently incorporates the trained model to determine the complete dispersion relation.
